theme: The last open Saturday before Croatia.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Nothing's on the calendar today, so it's the last clear Saturday before you sail — with the Halloween call due and a short stack of trip bookings still open.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The call is due today. The Oct 18-Nov 1 St Pete house and car both cover Halloween, and that booking fires while you're in Croatia -- so it can't wait for the boat.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Fifteen minutes at 9 to work the board -- clear the inbox, put an owner and date on everything, chase what you're waiting on. You haven't accepted the invite yet.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bags, in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags on Eurowings Discover, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's site and buy bags now -- counter fees run far higher.

needsAttention.title: Last Croatia nights unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat hotel for Sept 19 and the St Pete landing gap of Sept 20-22 are both still open. Connectivity aboard is poor, so lock them from dry land before you leave.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding with Paul
needsAttention.detail: Reach the Nautilus instructor to pin Saturday's boarding time and, more importantly, the return transfer to the airport -- easier to arrange now than once underway.

flagged.title: SVP, Government Affairs -- True Anomaly
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a senior government-affairs role posted Sept 4, squarely in your lane.

flagged.title: Sprayfoam estimate -- $12,450
flagged.detail: C&C Sprayfoam sent a QuickBooks estimate for the Maine house, marked due end of year.

flagged.title: AMEX balance alert
flagged.detail: myFICO flags your reported AMEX balance ticked up. A glance item, no action implied.

flagged.title: Nomura call still pending
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano at Valoris wants to set a call and floats a real Nomura project, though he doubts the budget. Awaiting your reply.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and booking chatter -- Bloomberg, Slightly Foxed, the Airbnb host thread.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is sitting on your reply this morning.

resolved.title: PRI call with Conor Kehoe
resolved.detail: You asked to push it past your trip and Kate agreed to reopen the diary when you're back. Nothing owed now.

resolved.title: St Pete house checked in
resolved.detail: The Sep 3-8 Airbnb host confirmed access and you're in -- that thread is closed.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first chestnuts and hearty greens worth building a warm salad around.

tasks.title: Book Sept 20-Oct 5 rental as a refundable backup
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar -- the clearest stretch of the week to close the open trip bookings.
The Halloween decision is due today, and the October booking is waiting on it.
The girls are in St Pete with you tonight, and Mike's 15-minute review lands at 9 tomorrow.
